title: Virginia DEQ Project Raspberry Permit Record
summary: Virginia DEQ's Project Raspberry page assembles a named data-center campus record across wetlands, stream impacts, mitigation submissions, and a June 2026 air-modeling requirement.
key_findings: DEQ received the joint permit application and Virginia Water Protection permit application on January 21, 2026.
The application identifies proposed permanent surface-water impacts and a mitigation trail.
DEQ issued an air-modeling requirement on June 16, 2026, while the water application remained under review.
why_it_matters: It demonstrates how a named campus can be followed across separate environmental approvals.
ftfn_relevance: Adds a project-level Virginia permitting comparator.
Connects compute siting to water and air evidence.
Keeps applications and agency requirements below final approval and operation.
evidence_limits: The page does not establish final approval for every required permit.
It does not prove construction, service, compliant operation, or local acceptance.
